<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a character">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" name="Set up account and think of names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CheckAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ThinkNames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CheckAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" name="Have a Battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountExists_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount_EnterInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount_EnterInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInfo_ClickLink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the link in the confirmation email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInfo_ClickLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClickLink_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccount_Merge" name="Continue with Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountExists_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClickLink_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSubscription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSubscription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckSubscription_SubscriptionGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckSubscription_SubscriptionGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActiveSubscription_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoSubscription_SelectPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select a payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoSubscription_SelectPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_PaymentGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Choose payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_PaymentGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_EnterInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount_EnterInfo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_EnterInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterIBANBIC" name="Enter IBAN and BIC">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount_EnterInfo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentDetails_Merge" name="Continue after payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" name="Continue after subscription check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActiveSubscription_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ThinkOfNames" name="Think of character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ThinkNames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThinkNames_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join" name="Account setup and names ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThinkNames_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Login" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_SelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select realm, race, and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_SelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectOptions_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter a character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectOptions_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameUnavailable_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_CheckAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check name availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_CheckAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAvailability_NameGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAvailability_NameGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameUnavailable_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive character confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_Selfies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveSelfies" name="Receive character selfies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_Selfies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Selfies_ExpansionRelease</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleaseMessage" name="Expansion release message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Selfies_ExpansionRelease</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpansionRelease_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CharacterProcess" name="Character process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpansionRelease_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ThinkNames" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists_AccountMerge" name="Account exists" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Battle.net account exists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount_EnterInfo" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No Battle.net account exists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfo_ClickLink" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_CheckSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSubscription_SubscriptionGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveSubscription_SubscriptionMerge" name="Active subscription" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Active WoW subscription exists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSubscription_SelectPayment" name="No active subscription" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No active WoW subscription exists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_PaymentGateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_EnterInfo" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Credit card selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount_EnterInfo" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterIBANBIC">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Bank account selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentDetails_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBANBIC" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentDetails_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentDetails_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNames_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfNames" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_SelectCharacterOptions" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectOptions_EnterName" sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_NameGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_Confirmation" name="Available" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Character name is available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable_EnterName" name="Unavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Character name is unavailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Selfies" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selfies_ExpansionRelease" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleaseMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionRelease_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleaseMessage" targetRef="EndEvent_CharacterProcess"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
